title: KlassApp
description: AI-native school management platform for African schools.
content: KlassApp turns the tools schools already use into one intelligent layer. Toshi, the platform's AI assistant, orchestrates WhatsApp, Slack, spreadsheets and the dashboard: parents receive fee reminders and report cards on WhatsApp, teachers enter marks from spreadsheets, and admins run operations from Slack — with role-based access, audit trails and human-in-the-loop approvals on every consequential action.
highlights: Toshi AI agent acting across WhatsApp, Slack, email, SMS and the dashboard
Automated fee reminders, attendance follow-ups and end-of-term reports
Role-based access control, audit trails and human-in-the-loop approvals
Open-source direction with MCP connector support

title: AfroDuuka
description: Inventory & retail operations platform for African businesses.
content: AfroDuuka gives growing African retailers real-time control over stock, sales, suppliers and branches — replacing notebooks and spreadsheets. Shop owners get WhatsApp low-stock alerts, daily sales summaries, one-click profit & loss reports and an AI business assistant that answers questions about the business in plain language.
highlights: Real-time inventory tracking across multiple branches
Automated WhatsApp low-stock alerts and daily sales summaries
Instant profit & loss reports and sales analytics
AfroDuuka Assistant — an AI advisor for inventory and sales decisions

title: Afro Invest
description: A secure investment platform for African SMEs and investors.
content: A full-stack investment platform where SMEs and investors manage portfolios, track transactions and follow returns end-to-end. Built as a Node.js and Express API over PostgreSQL with Prisma, with JWT authentication, strict input validation on every financial figure and a componentized React dashboard — designed so each transaction is validated and auditable before it ever touches the database.
highlights: Portfolio and transaction management with full validation
JWT authentication and auditable financial records
Express + Prisma service layer built for scale

title: E-commerce Platform
description: A local marketplace connecting nearby buyers and sellers.
content: A location-based marketplace that matches buyers with sellers nearby: listings are ranked by distance, and users get real-time notifications the moment something they're looking for is listed in their area. React on the frontend with a Node.js API over PostgreSQL, and background jobs handling the distance matching and notification delivery so the feed stays instant.
highlights: Real-time alerts for new listings in a user's area
Background jobs for matching and notification delivery
